topPRs.title: chore(biome): upgrade @biomejs/biome to 2.5.1 everywhere + reformat
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## What

Upgrades `@biomejs/biome` from **2.4.16 → 2.5.1** (latest stable) across the entire workspace and reformats the tree to 2.5.1's canonical style.

## Why

The workspace had a **biome version skew**: `package.json` files declared a mix of `2.4.16`, `2.5.0`, and `^2.4.14`, while `bun.lock` (and therefore CI's `bun install --frozen-lockfile`) resolved **2.4.16**. Because PR CI lint is path-gated (it only lints changed files), 2.5.x-formatted files merged via PRs that didn't touch them could slip in and then fail a full repo `bun run lint`. Pinning one version everywhere removes that whole class of intermittent lint drift.

## Changes

**Commit 1 — version bump (config only):**
- Pin `@biomejs/biome` to `2.5.1` in all **97** `package.json` files
- Regenerate `bun.lock` (resolves `2.4.16` → `2.5.1`)
- Bump `$schema` to `2.5.1` in all **68** `biome.json` configs
- Migrate the deprecated `linter.rules.recommended: true` → `linter.rules.preset: "recommended"` in **50** configs (behavior-identical; removes the 2.5.x deprecation diagnostic)

**Commit 2 — mechanical reformat:**
- `biome check --write` under the 2.5.1 toolchain (formatting + organizeImports only — **no logic changes**). The bulk of the diff is the trailing-comma behavior change between 2.4 and 2.5.

## Verification

- **Per-package lint green at 2.5.1:** serial sweep of all no-write first-party packages → **51 pass, 0 needing fixes, 0 residual lint errors**.
- `packages/core` typechecks clean (the reformat is format + import-ordering, which cannot change types).
- All `biome.json` configs validate at 2.5.1 (no `deserialize`/deprecation diagnostics; verified core/agent/app).

## Notes for the reviewer

- This is a large (~1100-file) **mechanical** change. The meaningful review surface is **commit 1** (versions + config). Commit 2 is pure formatter output.
- It's a repo-wide reformat, so it can go stale against an active `develop`. If it can't fast-forward at merge time, the cleanest sync is to **regenerate** rather than rebase: `bun install` then `bunx @biomejs/biome check --write .` on the latest `develop`. (At open time it rebased onto `develop` with **zero** conflicts.)

topPRs.title: fix(lifeops): de-larp + battle-test the scheduling/PA spine — recurrence, dispatch policy, approvals, honest tests
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## LifeOps / personal-assistant de-larp + battle-test campaign

Full audit and hardening of the LifeOps/PA stack (scheduling, calendar, email, reminders, todos, goals, check-ins, follow-ups, approvals) per #10721 #10723 #8795 #9310 #10757. Four parallel research audits (issues, runtime code, test corpus, optimization pipeline) produced file:line-verified findings; 41 commits land the fixes, every one with fail-without-fix regression proof.

### P0 correctness fixes (the system did not actually schedule anything)

- **Core task tick re-arm** (`1d7d008741`): the dirty-gate disarmed after the first 1s tick and `markDirty()` had zero callers — every repeat task (including the LifeOps 60s heartbeat) ran at most once per boot. 8 tests fail without the fix.
- **Recurrence made real** (`488814580d`): recurring tasks fired at most once ever (terminal-death via skip/complete + tick status filter; `fired` zombies raced forever; `acknowledged` excluded). CAS refire claim + widened partial index + refire-candidate slice. 14 tests fail without.
- **Frozen clock** (`15fe56184b`): the runner cached the first tick's `now` closure — `firedAt` was always boot time and completion timeouts became instantly due. Mutable clock ref.
- **Dispatch policy enforced** (`e7d258d3dc`, #10721 H2): typed `DispatchResult {ok:false}` was recorded as a successful fire — the user silently never received the message. Bounded retries, ladder escalation across channels, `connectorDegradation`, terminal fail + `pipeline.onFail`. 7/8 tests fail without.
- **Snooze-override indexing** (`81b625a974`): a snoozed daily reminder fired ~a day late; a snoozed `once` fell off the index entirely.
- **Heartbeat un-brick + tick isolation** (`54f45b152e`): 5 consecutive failures permanently paused LifeOps across restarts; one failing subsystem aborted the whole tick.
- **Approvals execute** (`87dccd1d71`, `79f673d4cd`, `0fce62eb2e`): approving a send/workflow/signature did NOTHING (executor discarded; dynamic worker name never registered; fake "Approved."); expired requests could be resurrected via TOCTOU in BOTH approval stores. Stable worker + CAS transitions everywhere.
- **Honest in_app dispatch** (`66e5d9d2c9`): the in-app branch fabricated `ok:true` with no live surface; delivery now counts real surfaces.
- **Fabrications deleted** (`883068c93b`, `8446a9d797`): the canned flight-conflict template (returned a scripted answer regardless of the calendar) and CONFLICT_DETECT's fake "No conflicts detected" (loader never wired); real CalendarService loader + honest `CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE`.
- **Reminder datetimes** (`a46f9eff13`, `ac78e9875a`): "remind me Friday" fired IMMEDIATELY (extraction schema had no date field → `dueAt = now`); reschedules were silent no-ops; snooze always 30min; English-keyword vetoes broke multilingual requests. Date+time extraction via the relative resolver, clarification-not-fabrication, date-level moves.
- **LLM-tolerant trigger boundary + duplicate guard** (`7273e0d981`): found by hand-reviewing a LIVE trajectory — the model's natural trigger shapes bounced (5 failed calls) and it created duplicate reminders across turns. Aliases normalize; failures teach the canonical shape; identical active tasks dedupe.
- **weekday_only honors params** (`b6c4bfbd7c`): Mon/Wed/Fri habits fired five days a week.
- **State-log rollover wired** (`94396230eb`): the documented nightly rollup had no caller; the log grew unbounded.
- Property tests caught + fixed 3 more: RangeError overflow mid-tick, same in persist path, ~26s Intl scan on garbage dates (`50b138bd67`).

### Test/scenario de-larp (#9310)

- **30 echo scenarios rewritten outcome-asserting**; echo ratchet lowered **237 → 215** (`c1ea8e78c4`, `e276a20920`) — approval flows now seed real queue rows and read back end-state; grounding via seeded tokens that appear in no user turn.
- **Larp tests fixed**: global-pause test drove a self-defined `shouldSkip` (could never fail) → now drives the real tick (`d8f04c08b4`); the "emergency fires while paused" e2e never ticked → real end-to-end; scenario-count file-grep theater → real loader + load-bearing-assertion gate (`2105d05893`); inbox classifier echo-of-mock → contract tests incl. fail-closed on malformed output (`deb025e2a9`); BRIEF pipeline pinned (`c802bddc7c`).
- **Keyless PR gate expanded ~6 → 11 LifeOps scenarios** (`24411f5ea1`): 4 reminder-ladder scenarios relabeled with per-title load-bearing assertions; NEW `deterministic-lifeops-dispatch-retry` + `deterministic-lifeops-recurrence` drive the REAL scheduler and fail when the P0 bugs are reintroduced (proven). PA `test:scenarios` now RUNS the gate instead of listing files.
- **Fuzz/property/DST suites** (`50b138bd67`): fast-check properties over due/next-fire/verb sequences; DST pins for NY+Berlin both transitions; runner fuzz with every typed failure.
- **Persona/adversarial/long-horizon corpus** (`b1d02290f5`): 26-task concurrent-day budget ledger + 5-day multiday journey (both keyless PR gate); 5 personas (elderly/ESL/typo/voice-transcription/chained-intents), prompt-injection-via-content, calendar triple-overlap (live lane).

### Optimization loop (#8795) + live lane (#10757)

- Training triggers now count LifeOps capabilities (`7cb9a1e46b`); optimization examples reward-weighted, failed-scenario trajectories excluded (`3534324f1a`); judge scores serialized numerically into reports + native export (`66d6e5e0ad`); batch `trajectories:review` per-capability scoreboard script (`7ad4351c4d`).
- **Live-LLM lane on a subscription-only host** (`7d62df0a57`): `cli` live provider (claude/codex CLI backends) + scenario-runtime bridge — proven with real runs.

### Evidence

- `.github/issue-evidence/10721-10723-lifeops-qa-checklist/` — 14-section QA checklist, every behavior tagged with its test + fail-without-fix count or an explicit GAP.
- `.github/issue-evidence/10757-cli-live-lane/` — live-lane proof run (report + trajectory listing).
- `.github/issue-evidence/10721-trigger-boundary-before-after/` — live before/after: 7 create calls (5 failed, 2 duplicates) → 1 call, first try; plus the capability-routing finding for #8795.

### Verification (all local, final branch)

- plugin-scheduling: 196 tests / 18 files. PA: 894 tests / 117 files + 19-test src-integration lane + 8-test trigger boundary. core task services: 13. agent approvals: 10. scenario-runner: 187 / 25 files (ratchets + guards). Keyless CI corpus gate: **31/31**. lifeops-bench scorer+schema: 263.
- Typecheck clean: core, agent (approval scope), plugin-scheduling, PA, scenario-runner, plugin-training.

### Follow-ups filed

#10999 (route-actor header spoof — security), #11046 (core cron DST fall-back double-fire + scan perf), #11047 (repo integration lane dead in flat checkouts). Remaining tracked residuals (no-reply channel escalation product call, default-pack seeding unification with #10953 H1, `tz:"owner_local"`, live-credential #8833 lane) enumerated in the QA checklist GAP rows and the issue close-out comments.

Refs #10721 #10723 #8795 #9310 #10757 #8833 #8792
